title: Littlecote Roman Villa

buildingCutout.basis: Mapped footprint of the standing roof and its visitor deck.

terrainReference.basis: Original national LiDAR bare earth immediately outside the south edge of the conservation shelter.

mapIdentity.provider: Named map precinct, separately mapped roof and twenty surviving stone lines.
mapIdentity.scope: Named scheduled site, twenty current mapped wall traces, and the separately mapped polygon of the standing conservation shelter. The visible pavement follows the excavated Orphic room at the far north end of the villa.

note: The exact Przemysław Jahr Qualla originals show low rubble wall caps, the sheltered mosaic and timber cross-braced railings. Archaeological reporting specifies a 41 by 25 foot triconch-and-rectangular room separated from the villa. The local restoration record confirms the renewed shingled cover in April 2026.
